notes: Full test (BLEO, jauge du 4/11 : 2 full tests sur 6). Accroche jamais faite chez nous (ni « younger self » dans le label). Accroches écrites : « what i'd tell my younger self about studying » (retenue : la forme lettre à soi-même, sincère, qu'on partage), « study advice i needed at 14 » (écartée : âge qui exclut une partie des comptes), « things nobody told me about studying » (écartée : proche de « i wish someone told me »). slides.texte_overlay:
what i'd tell my younger self
about studying

rereading your notes 5 times isn't studying.
it just feels like it.

close the notes and test yourself.
what you can't answer is what you need to learn.

ask for help the first week you're lost.
not the week before the exam.

your phone in the same room is a distraction even when it's silent.
put it somewhere else.

20 minutes a day beats 5 hours on sunday.
every single time.

one bad grade is information, not who you are.
look at what went wrong and fix that one thing.
and go to sleep. you're not lazy, you're tired.
